title: The ZCC Terraform provider: where its behavior is described

prose.text: This walks the subjects that describe what the ZCC Terraform provider, a Plugin Framework provider, sends, reads and reports. Which API paths and SDK packages each resource uses, and its arguments (type, required or optional, computed, defaults, enum values and validators, nested blocks), are generated from the provider code: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <resource name>`; `provider:zcc` gives the provider's own settings.

prose.label: Configuring the provider.
prose.text: Credentials, environment variables and retry defaults are in [[zcc.terraform.provider-config]]; what has no resource is in [[zcc.terraform.coverage]].

prose.label: What reaches the API.
prose.text: Fields not sent, not read back or collapsed, mostly on forwarding profiles, are in [[zcc.terraform.field-fidelity]]. How trusted networks pick the v1 or v2 API is in [[zcc.terraform.trusted-network-backend]].

prose.label: Through the SDK.
prose.text: Paging limits that drop records from state are in [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]], zero values that cannot be sent in [[shared.sdk-go.zero-value-writes]], and legacy-mode routing in [[zcc.sdk-go.legacy-routing]].
